entries.name: Warning
entries.explanation: An official warning from race control. After three warnings you get a 10-second time penalty, then 20 seconds at the next one.

entries.name: 2 penalty points
entries.explanation: 2 penalty points. At 10 points you get a drive-through (SPDT) and your points go back to 0. Points carry over to the next race.

entries.name: 3 penalty points
entries.explanation: 3 penalty points. At 10 points you get a drive-through (SPDT) and your points go back to 0. Points carry over to the next race.

entries.name: 5 penalty points
entries.explanation: 5 penalty points. At 10 points you get a drive-through (SPDT) and your points go back to 0. Points carry over to the next race.

entries.name: 5-second time penalty
entries.explanation: 5 seconds are added to your race time after the race. Nothing to serve on track: keep racing.

entries.name: 10-second time penalty
entries.explanation: 10 seconds are added to your race time after the race. Nothing to serve on track: keep racing.

entries.name: 20-second time penalty
entries.explanation: 20 seconds are added to your race time after the race. Nothing to serve on track: keep racing.

entries.name: 30-second time penalty
entries.explanation: 30 seconds are added to your race time after the race. Nothing to serve on track: keep racing.

entries.name: Drive-through
entries.explanation: Drive through the pit lane at the pit speed limit without stopping. iRacing shows the black flag until you have served it.

entries.name: Cumulative drive-through (10 points)
entries.explanation: You reached 10 penalty points: drive through the pit lane at the pit speed limit. Your points go back to 0. iRacing shows the black flag until you have served it.

entries.name: 10-second stop and go
entries.explanation: Stop in your pit box for 10 seconds, then rejoin. iRacing shows the black flag until you have served it.

entries.name: 20-second stop and go
entries.explanation: Stop in your pit box for 20 seconds, then rejoin. iRacing shows the black flag until you have served it.

entries.name: 30-second stop and go
entries.explanation: Stop in your pit box for 30 seconds, then rejoin. iRacing shows the black flag until you have served it.

entries.name: 3-place grid drop
entries.explanation: You start 3 places further back in the next race. Nothing changes in this race.

entries.name: Disqualification
entries.explanation: You are disqualified from this race and get no result.
